title: Meditech Users Network Annual Conference
summary: The Consensus team is heading to Liverpool for the Meditech Users Network Annual Conference! Centered on realizing the full value of MEDITECH investments, this event brings together NHS trusts and care providers dedicated to modernizing clinical workflows and defending against emerging security threats. body_markdown:
The Consensus team is heading to Liverpool for the Meditech Users Network Annual Conference! Centered on realizing the full value of MEDITECH investments, this event brings together NHS trusts and care providers dedicated to modernizing clinical workflows and defending against emerging security threats.


Connect with our experts on-site to learn how healthcare organizations can create greater continuity across hospital, community and home-based care by connecting clinical systems, securely extending access to information beyond the hospital and supporting more seamless transitions of care.


[Learn More](https://meditechusersnetwork.co.uk/mun-conference/)
